test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

The ticket collector asked the passengers where their tickets were.

options.text: The ticket collector said to the passengers, “Where your tickets were?”
The ticket collector said to the passengers, “Where were your tickets?”
The ticket collector demanded the passengers, “Show me your tickets”
The ticket collector said to the passengers, “Where are your tickets?”

solution:
The correct answer is "**The ticket collector said to the passengers, “Where are your tickets?”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is in indirect speech; the challenge is converting it back to direct speech accurately.
 
• The correct direct speech maintains the query's present tense as it would have been spoken in real-time.
 
• “Where are your tickets?” accurately reflects how the ticket collector would have asked the question.
 
• It follows the correct punctuation and structure for direct speech representation.

**Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 4".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1) introduces a malformed question syntax.
 
• Option 2) reverses the word order incorrectly for a direct question.
 
• Option 3) changes the nature of the request into a demand, which does not match the indirect statement.
